about: The fixture ticket is missing its Validation section, so the Ready checklist fails and triage sends it to the ticket drafter's revise step. The stand-in writes the ticket drafter's own example result for revised (the role's instructions, JP-184) and the revision it names; the walker must accept it, the revision is applied, and the ticket goes on to Ready.

checks.check: a run started for the ticket
the run ended at its end state
the fake Jira shows the ticket in the status the graph sets
every Jira call carried the credentials found the laptop's way (email only in state/jira-email)
the entry gate admitted the run
the walker recorded revise with the outcome revised
